features.title: Instant Context Awareness
features.description: Hypa detects the source language automatically and keeps the original beside the translation so you never lose context.

features.title: Voice Input & Playback
features.description: Dictate in your native language, then listen to accurate pronunciation with customizable natural voices.

features.title: Tone Controls That Fit the Moment
features.description: Switch between formal, casual, or slang modes to localize responses for business, social, or on-the-go conversations.

features.title: Smart History & Favorites
features.description: Every translation is saved with quick filters, favorites, and cross-device sync so you can reuse important phrases fast.

features.title: Launch Hypa Anywhere
features.description: Use the browser extension, inline selection menu, or keyboard shortcut to translate without switching apps.

faqs.title: How do I translate text or webpages fastest?
faqs.description: Paste or drop text directly into Hypa, or use the browser extension to translate any page in one click. Hypa auto-detects the source language and keeps the original side-by-side so you can compare instantly.

faqs.title: Can Hypa read translations out loud?
faqs.description: Yes. Tap the speaker icon to hear the translation in a natural voice. You can also switch voices or set Hypa to auto-play audio in Settings.

faqs.title: What happens to my translation history?
faqs.description: Hypa stores your recent translations securely across devices when you're signed in. Favorite important phrases to pin them, or clear entries any time from History settings.

faqs.title: Does Hypa work offline?
faqs.description: You need an internet connection for translations, but your history and favorites are cached locally for quick reference.
